description: This file defines a FreeMarker template transformation class for rendering wrapped text URLs within the OFBiz framework. It implements the TemplateTransformModel interface to provide custom template processing, specifically for wrapping URL content in templates.

classes.name: RenderWrappedTextTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform class that outputs wrapped URL text in templates. It provides a custom Writer implementation that writes the wrapped content or logs an info message if absent.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that outputs the wrappedFTL string if it exists; otherwise logs an info message and skips writing.
